policy: Classify collision-repair advertising search terms conservatively. Uncertain or contradictory intent must be HUMAN_REVIEW, never guessed as negative.

rules.title: Serious collision intent
rules.instruction: KEEP searches expressing collision, crash, accident, frame-damage, auto-body repair, or body-shop service intent, including local and vehicle-brand variations.

rules.title: Body work intent
rules.instruction: KEEP genuine automotive body-work and body-shop searches. The words body work or body works are not negative by themselves.

rules.title: Organization name protection
rules.instruction: KEEP a search for the advertised organization's own name when the account context establishes that match.
examples: auto arena body shop when that is the account name

rules.title: Clearly unrelated or unwanted service
rules.instruction: NEGATIVE_EXACT only when the full search clearly seeks a non-collision service, product, job, education, DIY information, salvage inventory, unrelated mechanic, or another clearly irrelevant outcome.
examples: auto salvage yards with online inventory

rules.title: Ambiguity and conflicts
rules.instruction: HUMAN_REVIEW when context is insufficient, intent is mixed, a term could describe a valid collision service, or rules/examples conflict.

rules.title: Exact full-query output
rules.instruction: For NEGATIVE_EXACT, negativeText must equal the complete submitted searchTerm exactly. Never shorten, stem, rewrite, broaden, or create a phrase negative.
